name: realtalk
license: research (Lee et al. 2025, arXiv 2502.13270; no license file in source repo)
notes: 10 real (not synthetic) 21-day dyadic messaging conversations, 16-21 sessions each, per-session event annotations; 728 memory-probing QA in LoCoMo format (categories 1 multi-hop, 2 temporal, 3 commonsense/world-knowledge -- LoCoMo's 4/5 don't exist here). Fills the 'everything else long-term here is synthetic' gap. Raw: data/raw/realtalk/repo (git clone). Quirk: in Chat_1 speaker labels are handles (Emi/elise) but QA uses real names (Kate/Emily) -- see adapter docstring.
